Runtime: 1 Hour 23 Minutes 

There may be spoilers in the rest of the review

Story: A Neglected Wife starts when Belinda (Lawson) struggles to connect to her husband Quincy (Laster). She has been trying to rekindle the spark they once had, but something is not connecting. When temptation leads Belinda into the life of Cordell (Rowe), an affair takes a twisted turn.

She is left caught in the middle of a whirlwind romance or the loveless marriage she feels trapped in. However, things spiral as an unexpected event cause her even more tension and the lives of everyone involved become much more complicated.

Verdict on A Neglected Wife

Recap

The movie follows a wife in a loveless marriage drawn to an affair. However, when things spiral out of control, she must rush to save what is left of her life before everything comes crashing down.

Best Parts

Finding Writing Tools
movies

The vision of the loveless marriage is very vivid and conveys the emptiness Belinda is experiencing. It works perfectly for the movie and shows the daily strain.

Worst Parts

The final twists and turns in the potential affair are generic, plain and uninspiring. It leaves us not gaining much interest in what is happening and leads to the film falling out of focus becoming too generic.

Where to Watch

A Neglected Wife (8/25/26 TVOD Release)

Final Thoughts –A Neglected Wife is a generic, plain and uninspiring story.
